title: Mahjong Doukyuusei Special
overview: Mahjong Doukyuusei Special is a follow-up to Mahjong Doukyuusei, once again a strip mahjong game based on the Doukyuusei series of adult adventure games. This edition is again a 2-player riichi mahjong game, but features improved cel animation and a new cast of ladies to disrobe. There are six opponents in total, two of whom return from the previous edition: Hiromi Machida, Satomi Kurokawa, Mako Saito, Natsuko Masaki, Yoshiko Serizawa, and the main heroine Mai Sakuragi. As in the original version, there are no game options, only a straightforward arcade story mode where each opponent is played in order.
